This works well and it's certainly easy to find — clicking "Import & export" in the sidebar opened a clear area with a spot to bring my browser bookmarks in and a spot to download a copy of my library, both plainly labelled. So finding it is no trouble at all.

Your instinct is right, though: bringing my existing pile in is really a one-time thing at the start, and downloading a backup copy is something I'd do now and then, not daily. So having it sit permanently in the sidebar right alongside "All bookmarks," "Read later," and my labels feels a touch too prominent for how rarely I'll touch it — those everyday spots are what I want front and center, and this could crowd them a little. I'd happily see the more tucked-away version you mentioned before I decide. Show me the compact one.
